properties.rationale: User (who:ajs, standing policy from 2026-07-23, re-affirmed 2026-07-24): validation happens through the trials programme — docs/trials/ (self-host, adopt dogfood, erosion, phase-coverage, fleet feedback) is where "built the right thing" is exercised against operational intent; formal validation-kind Verification nodes are not this project's tracking mechanism. The gap re-fired only because its affected set grew by one: cap:derived-completion (BL-104) joins the same disposition. Worth noting that it is a better-than-average fit for the policy rather than an awkward one — whether "20 of 30 delivered" is the RIGHT number to compute is not a question a unit test can answer, and it will be settled by whether the figure proves useful when someone actually asks what to work on next, which is precisely a trial rather than a check.
